intent.proves: At least one visible Manage addresses app is set to include addresses of users with the same customer number.
intent.scope: active UserAddresses paragraphs on active pages; Source setting value observed on a 10.29.x baseline

bindings.reason: Reads one paragraph's settings; enumerating all UserAddresses paragraphs needs a handler.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName = 'UserAddresses' AND p.ParagraphModuleSettings LIKE '%<Source>OwnAddressesAndAddressesOfUsersWithSameCustomerNumber</Source>%'
